items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You say he was here on a show? He wrestled Big Chief Moore? [INTERVIEWEE] You knew him, eh? ... [INTERVIEWER] Did Moore come from Oklahoma or someplace up there? ... [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know where he's from.

ctx.x: You say he was here on a show? He wrestled Big Chief Moore?
